shared_elements: shallow incised curvilinear/outlined motifs on a stone surface
raised relief carving standing out from a plain ground
justification: The only correspondence is the generic practice of combining raised relief with shallow incised outlined motifs on a plain stone ground; nothing specific is shared. A depicts a crouching quadruped in bold high relief beside a splayed five-fingered hand/paw in low relief, whereas B depicts a monumental anthropomorphic figure whose back bears abstract rings, arcs and belt-like bands, with no animal and no hand.
